g10-geography-ug5-t1.overview: Overview of Employment Structure in the World sits inside Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa. Economic activities in Africa are the focus of Unit 5 of Grade 10 Geography in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it sets out the world’s employment structure across the primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary sectors. Then it surveys farming, mining, forestry, fishing, industry, and services on the continent. Next, it weighs the factors that hold back growth, from weak technology to aid dependence, and the poverty trap. Also it looks at unemployment and practical solutions, including sustainable development. Finally, it introduces Agenda 2063, the Sustainable Development Goals, and Africa’s rich language and religious diversity. Students will also learn how economic activities in Africa apply to real-life situations, such as jobs, trade, and enterprise.
